name: Nanjou Ibuki
source:
A tennis player who always travels around the world, but now she temporarily returned to Japan to take care of her injured hand. Due to this, she transfers to [url=/c1089]Shinobu's[/url] high school and becomes his classmate. Her personality is bright and energetic. However, she is quite boyish comparing to [url=/c1084]Aoi[/url], Shinobu's sister-in-law. 

Hobbies: Collecting cute things
Favorite Food: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Onigiri]Onigiri[/url]

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106181]Getchu[/url].]
